# Value Report: Invoicing for freelancers in Saudi Arabia

**Verdict:** Real but narrow value: freelancers patch invoices by hand and pay for help to connect to the tax portal. Half the evidence is first-hand.

Confirmed for ideas: NEED-1 (2026-10-30)

## Summary
Freelancers build invoices in spreadsheets (S-1) and hire help to connect to the tax portal (S-2).

## Top needs

| ID | Need (job) | Persona | Imp. | Sat. | Opportunity | Frequency | Confidence | Places (first-hand / all) | WTP signals |
|----|------------|---------|------|------|-------------|-----------|------------|---------------------------|-------------|
| NEED-1 | Issue compliant invoices without manual fixes | PER-1 | 8 | 3 | 13 | recurring | Medium | 2 / 3 | strong |
| NEED-2 | Know the reporting deadline | PER-1 | 5 | 6 | 5 | concentrated | Low (hypothesis) | 1 / 1 | none |

## Needs in detail

### NEED-1 Issue compliant invoices without manual fixes
- **Job:** JOB-1 (PER-1): issue a compliant invoice for each client job. Outcome: Minimize the time it takes to issue a compliant invoice. Source: S-1.
- **Evidence:** S-1, S-2, S-3

### NEED-2 Know the reporting deadline
- Hypothesis: freelancers miss deadlines. Evidence: S-4

## Personas
- **PER-1 Solo freelancer:** designer or developer; top three pains: manual invoices, portal setup, slow support; top three gains: speed, compliance, low cost. Source: S-1.
